blocks.text: Ai-Ai delas Alas, 61, proved that age is just a number as she powered through physically demanding challenges to complete the HYROX Rome fitness race. The actress reflected on her journey while showing a compilation of clips from the fitness event through her Instagram page on Saturday, Sept. 26. “I am almost 62. I challenged myself to race HYROX Solo,” she began. “The cramps in both my legs, from top to bottom, were so painful that I wanted to quit.
